_comment: Gamepad (GDD 12.3, M0-07/M9-02), by SDL game-controller button names (pygame CONTROLLER_BUTTON_*, lower case, without the prefix). Left stick walks, the right stick aims (guard and ground skills). skillBar = the bar slots in order: X, Y, B, right shoulder; with the left shoulder held, X and Y are slots 5 and 6. a = attack the nearest monster, or pick up / talk to what is next to you. Menus: the d-pad moves, a presses, b goes back. deadZone and aimTiles are fractions of the stick and tiles in front of the hero.
